problems: A dark crescent shows on the right end of the trunk, just under the lid. The ends of the squashed lid cylinder sit flush with the body's end faces at x = ±0.5 and dip below the rim, so the surfaces overlap and render as a black gap. Fix: make the dome slightly shorter than the body and sit it on top of the lid rim so its lower half is hidden inside the rim and body.

The trunk's wood reads as light orange-tan, almost the same as the platform planks, so the trunk does not stand out from the floor and does not read as wood brown. Fix: make the trunk a deeper brown and make the platform planks a paler, greyer weathered wood.
The platform reads as a pale cream or white surface, not a wooden station platform. The plank colours (#b8a081 etc.) wash out to near-white under the light. They need warmer, darker wood tones.

The proportions read as a pirate treasure chest, not a steamer trunk. The body is low (0.5) and the half-cylinder lid dome is tall. A steamer trunk has a taller body and a gentler, lower curve on the lid.
The front latch plate (z 0.37-0.49) overlaps the upper wooden band at z 0.37, so the band runs into the plate. The bands should clear the latch.
